Make the write path idempotent, or make it confirm before it can act twice.
en.summary: You have a capability the platform did not ship with, and a rule for how far up the ladder to climb next time.

zh.name: 越过预建连接器去扩展
zh.teaches: 从自定义连接器，到 REST/MCP 工具，再到第二个 agent 的能力阶梯，以及每一级后续要付的维护代价。
zh.build: 一个预建连接器够不到的能力，接进来，并把契约和失败行为写清楚。
zh.objective: 够到预建连接器覆盖不了的能力，并且用「能够到的最低那一级」去做。

tools: 一个你有权调用的 API、MCP 端点或第二个 agent
materials: 被调用方的输入输出契约

steps: 先说清楚哪件事是预建连接器够不到的。如果其实够得到，就到此为止，直接用。
取能解决问题的最低一级：自定义连接器 → REST/MCP → 第二个 agent。
动手接之前先把输入输出契约写下来，包括「出错长什么样」。
决定这个工具是让模型自由调用，还是只能由某个具名技能或工作流调用。
写操作要做成幂等的，否则就必须在可能重复执行前先确认。
zh.summary: 你有了一个平台没自带的能力，也有了一条「下次该爬到第几级」的判断标准。

en.act: Prove no prebuilt connector reaches it
en.where: Build → Tools → Add tool → Connectors
en.do: Search the connector list for your system, and for the vendor's name, before you accept that you need to build anything.
en.see: Either it is there — in which case this module is over, use it — or the search comes back empty.
en.note: Half the custom connectors in the world exist because nobody searched. The ladder only starts where this search fails.

zh.act: 先证明确实没有现成连接器
zh.where: Build → Tools → Add tool → Connectors
zh.do: 先拿系统名搜一遍，再拿厂商名搜一遍，再下「得自己做」这个结论。
zh.see: 要么它就在那儿——那这一课到此结束，直接用；要么搜出来是空的。
zh.note: 世上一半的自定义连接器都是因为没人搜一下。能力阶梯从这次搜索失败才开始。

en.act: Take the lowest rung that actually gets there
en.where: Build → Tools → Add tool — Featured, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Connectors, Workflows
en.do: Choose deliberately and say why out loud: a workflow, a connector, an MCP server, or a second agent.
en.see: Four categories, and they are four different long-term commitments rather than four ways to do the same thing.
en.note: Every rung up is something your organisation owns forever. Climbing one rung too high is the most expensive decision in this module.

zh.act: 取能解决问题的最低一级
zh.where: Build → Tools → Add tool——Featured、Model Context Protocol (MCP)、Connectors、Workflows
zh.do: 有意识地选，并当场说出理由：一条工作流、一个连接器、一个 MCP server，还是第二个 agent。
zh.see: 四个分类——而它们不是四种做同一件事的方式，是四种不同的长期承诺。
zh.note: 每往上爬一级，都是你们公司要养一辈子的东西。多爬一级，是这一课里最贵的决定。

en.act: Look in the MCP catalogue before you build anything
en.where: Add a tool → Model Context Protocol (MCP)
en.do: Read the list. Dataverse, the Dynamics 365 apps, Azure Data Explorer, Microsoft Learn Docs and the Microsoft 365 servers are all already there.
en.see: Servers, not individual actions — one entry brings a whole tool surface with it.
en.note: This is the rung most teams skip straight past on their way to writing a custom connector nobody will maintain. Check it first, every time.

zh.act: 动手建之前，先翻一遍 MCP 目录
zh.where: Add a tool → Model Context Protocol (MCP)
zh.do: 把列表读一遍。Dataverse、各个 Dynamics 365 应用、Azure Data Explorer、Microsoft Learn Docs 以及 Microsoft 365 那几个 server，都已经在里面了。
zh.see: 列的是 server，不是单个动作——加一条，带进来的是一整块工具面。
zh.note: 大多数团队就是跳过这一级，直接去写一个后来没人维护的自定义连接器。每次都先看这里。

en.act: Write the contract before you wire anything
en.where: On paper
en.do: Write down the inputs with their types, the output shape, and what an error looks like coming back.
en.see: Three short lists. The error one is the one everybody forgets and the one that decides how this behaves in production.
en.note: Do this before the connection exists. Once something returns data, nobody goes back and defines what failure means.

zh.act: 接线之前先把契约写下来
zh.where: 写在纸上
zh.do: 把入参及其类型、返回结构、以及「出错时回来的东西长什么样」全写下来。
zh.see: 三张短单子。其中错误那张最容易被忘，却决定了这东西在生产环境里的表现。
zh.note: 必须在连接存在之前写。一旦能返回数据了，就再也没人回头定义失败是什么。

en.act: Decide who may call it
en.where: Build → Tools → the new tool
en.do: Choose whether the model may reach for this freely, or only a named skill or workflow may invoke it, and write the description accordingly.
en.see: A tool the agent either picks up on its own, or one that sits there until a specific path calls it.
en.note: Anything that writes, spends or notifies should be the second kind until you have watched it choose correctly a hundred times.

zh.act: 定下谁能调它
zh.where: Build → Tools → 新加的那个工具
zh.do: 决定是让模型自由取用，还是只允许某个具名技能或工作流调用，并按这个决定写描述。
zh.see: 要么是一个 agent 会自己伸手去拿的工具，要么是一个没人叫就不动的工具。
zh.note: 凡是会写入、会花钱、会发通知的，先一律归后一类——直到你亲眼看它选对一百次。

en.act: Run the write twice
en.where: Preview tab
en.do: Trigger the same write action twice in a row, exactly as an impatient user would.
en.see: Either one record and a sensible message, or two records and nobody the wiser.
en.note: Users double-send. If a second identical call creates a second record, you do not have a tool — you have a duplicate generator with a confirmation dialog for a fig leaf.

zh.act: 把写操作连跑两次
zh.where: Preview 页签
zh.do: 把同一个写动作连着触发两次，就像一个没耐心的用户那样。
zh.see: 要么只多了一条记录加一句得体的提示，要么两条记录且没人发现。
zh.note: 用户就是会双击。第二次一模一样的调用又建了一条，那你做的不是工具，是一台带确认弹窗的重单机。

en.name: Test it before you ship it
en.teaches: Building a test set with agreed expected answers, and using it as a gate rather than a formality.
en.build: A re-runnable test set, a pass threshold the business agreed to, and one regression you caught with it.
en.objective: Decide whether the agent is fit to pilot from a test set you can re-run, rather than from a demo that went well.

materials: Questions with agreed correct answers, including ones it should refuse

steps: Write the test set before you tune anything, or you will only write tests it already passes.
Cover five kinds: the normal case, the edge, the out-of-scope, the unauthorised, and a multi-turn exchange.
Agree the pass threshold with whoever owns the process, in writing, before you run it.
Change one thing, re-run the whole set, and look at what else moved.
On a failure, read the activity trace to find which step actually broke rather than guessing at the prompt.
en.summary: Shipping is now a decision against a threshold, instead of a feeling about how the demo went.

zh.name: 上线之前先把它测了
zh.teaches: 建一套有约定标准答案的测试集，并且真的把它当闸门用，而不是走个过场。
zh.build: 一套可重复运行的测试集、一个业务方认可的通过线，以及一个靠它抓出来的回归。
zh.objective: 靠一套能反复跑的测试集来判断能不能试点，而不是靠「刚才那次演示挺顺」。

materials: 带约定标准答案的问题集，包括那些它应该拒绝的

steps: 在调优之前先把测试集写完，否则你写出来的只会是它已经能过的题。
覆盖五类：正常、边界、范围外、越权、以及一次多轮对话。
跑之前，先和流程负责人把通过线白纸黑字定下来。
只改一处，把整套重跑一遍，看看还有什么跟着动了。
失败时去读活动轨迹，找出到底是哪一步断的，而不是对着提示词猜。
zh.summary: 「能不能上」从此是对着一条线做判断，而不是对着一次演示凭感觉。

en.act: Write the test set before you tune anything
en.where: Evaluate → Evaluation → New evaluation → Data source, using the CSV template
en.do: Download the template and fill it in with real questions and the answers the business agrees are correct.
en.see: A file, not a list in your head — which means somebody else can run it after you leave.
en.note: Write it first. Tests written after tuning are a record of what the agent already does, dressed up as a standard.

zh.act: 调优之前先把测试集写完
zh.where: Evaluate → Evaluation → New evaluation → Data source，用那份 CSV 模板
zh.do: 把模板下下来，填上真实问题，以及业务方认可的标准答案。
zh.see: 一个文件，而不是一份存在你脑子里的清单——也就意味着你走了以后别人还能跑。
zh.note: 先写。调优之后才补的测试，只是把「agent 现在能干什么」换个标准的名字写一遍。

en.act: Cover five kinds, not five phrasings of one
en.where: Your test file
en.do: Include the normal case, the edge, the out-of-scope, the unauthorised, and one multi-turn exchange.
en.see: A set where at least two rows expect a refusal rather than an answer.
en.note: A test set with no expected refusals is not a test set. It is a demo script with a spreadsheet around it.

zh.act: 覆盖五类，而不是同一类的五种问法
zh.where: 你那份测试文件
zh.do: 正常、边界、范围外、越权、一段多轮对话——一类不能少。
zh.see: 至少有两行的预期结果是「应该拒绝」，而不是「应该回答」。
zh.note: 一份没有预期拒绝的测试集不是测试集。那是套了个表格壳的演示脚本。

en.act: Load it and run the first pass
en.where: Evaluate → New evaluation → drag the CSV in
en.do: Run the set and record the pass rate before you change a single thing.
en.see: A number, and a list of which rows failed.
en.note: There is also a Quick conversation set that generates ten conversations from the agent's own instructions. Useful for a first look, useless as a gate — it tests the agent against itself.

zh.act: 导进去，跑第一遍
zh.where: Evaluate → New evaluation → 把 CSV 拖进去
zh.do: 跑完整一套，在改任何东西之前先把通过率记下来。
zh.see: 一个数，以及一张「哪几行没过」的单子。
zh.note: 旁边还有个 Quick conversation set，能根据 agent 自己的说明生成十段对话。初看可以，当闸门不行——它是拿 agent 考 agent 自己。

en.act: Agree the pass threshold in writing
en.where: With whoever owns the process, before you tune
en.do: Get a number: what pass rate makes this fit to pilot, and which rows must never fail regardless of the average.
en.see: One number and a short must-pass list, both with a name against them.
en.note: Agree it before you know your score. Thresholds set afterwards are always just above whatever you happened to get.

zh.act: 把通过线白纸黑字定下来
zh.where: 调优之前，和流程负责人一起定
zh.do: 要一个数：通过率到多少算能试点；以及哪几行不管均值多好都不允许失败。
zh.see: 一个数加一张必过清单，两者后面都签了名字。
zh.note: 必须在知道分数之前定。事后定的线，永远刚好卡在你这次考了多少分上面一点点。

en.act: Change one thing and re-run everything
en.where: Build → Instructions or a tool description, then Evaluate again
en.do: Make one change, re-run the whole set, and compare row by row against the first pass.
en.see: The row you were fixing now passes — and one or two you were not thinking about have moved.
en.note: Never re-run only the failures. Instructions are global; the damage always shows up somewhere you were not looking.

zh.act: 只改一处，整套重跑
zh.where: Build → Instructions 或某个工具描述，改完再回 Evaluate
zh.do: 改一处，把整套重跑，和第一遍逐行对比。
zh.see: 你要修的那行过了——同时有一两行你根本没想过的跟着动了。
zh.note: 绝不要只重跑失败的那几行。说明是全局的，损伤总是出现在你没看的地方。

en.act: On a failure, read the trace before you touch the prompt
en.where: The failing row → its activity trace
en.do: Work out which step broke: retrieval, tool choice, the tool itself, or the wording of the answer.
en.see: Usually not the step you assumed. Wrong-tool failures read exactly like instruction failures from the outside.
en.note: Editing the instructions is the most common wrong fix in this whole programme. It changes the symptom and leaves the cause.

zh.act: 失败时先读轨迹，别碰提示词
zh.where: 失败的那一行 → 它的活动轨迹
zh.do: 定位到底是哪一步断的：检索、选工具、工具本身，还是措辞。
zh.see: 通常不是你以为的那一步。选错工具从外面看，和说明写得不好一模一样。
zh.note: 上来就改说明，是整个课程里最常见的错误修法。它只换掉了症状，病因还在。

en.name: Hand the work to a second agent
en.teaches: When to split an agent instead of adding another tool, how the routing decision is described, and what actually crosses the boundary at the handover.
en.build: A refusal turned into a handoff, with the context that may cross the boundary decided rather than assumed.
en.objective: Route a request your agent should not answer to one that should, and say exactly what went across with it.

tools: A second agent you may connect to — build a small one if you have none
materials: The question your agent currently refuses, and whoever owns the answer to it

steps: Take the question your agent refuses today, and decide honestly: another tool, or another agent?
State the second agent's job in one sentence. If it takes two, you are splitting in the wrong place.
Connect it, and describe the route by when to hand over — not by what the other agent is.
Ask the clear-cut case and confirm the handoff; then ask one that spans both and watch how it splits the work.
Check what crossed: every field of context that went over, and whether it was allowed to.
Find the handoff in the activity trace and confirm an auditor could follow it without your help.
en.summary: Work leaves your agent for another one on purpose, and you can say what went with it — which is the question security will ask first.

zh.name: 把活交给第二个 agent
zh.teaches: 什么时候该拆一个 agent 而不是再加一个工具、路由的判断怎么描述、以及交接那一刻到底有什么越过了边界。
zh.build: 把一次「不归我管」变成一次交接，并且过界的上下文是定下来的，不是默认过去的。
zh.objective: 能把本该别人答的请求路由给该答的那个 agent，并说清楚跟着过去的是什么。

tools: 一个你可以连的第二个 agent——没有就现场建一个小的
materials: 你的 agent 现在会拒绝的那个问题，以及那个问题该谁答

steps: 拿出你的 agent 今天会拒绝的那个问题，老实判断一次：是再加个工具，还是该拆个 agent？
用一句话说清第二个 agent 的职责。要说两句才说得清，就说明你拆错地方了。
连上它，路由描述写「什么时候该转过去」，不要写「那个 agent 是什么」。
先问一个界限分明的，确认转对了；再问一个跨两边的，看它怎么把活拆开。
检查过界的东西：传过去的每一个上下文字段，以及它到底该不该过去。
在活动轨迹里找到这次交接，确认审计的人不用你帮忙也追得下去。
zh.summary: 活是有意识地被交出去的，而且你说得出跟着过去的是什么——这正是安全同事会先问的那一句。

en.act: Find the refusal you are going to convert
en.where: Preview tab
en.do: Ask your agent the out-of-scope question it currently declines, and read the refusal carefully.
en.see: A polite dead end. Correct behaviour, and a bad experience — the user still has the problem they arrived with.
en.note: This is the seam. Everything in this module is about turning a correct refusal into a useful outcome.

zh.act: 找到你要改造的那句拒绝
zh.where: Preview 页签
zh.do: 把那个它现在会拒绝的、范围外的问题问一遍，把拒绝语仔细读一遍。
zh.see: 一个很客气的死胡同。行为是对的，体验是差的——用户带来的问题还在那里。
zh.note: 接口就在这里。这一课干的就是把一句正确的拒绝，变成一个有用的结果。

en.act: Decide honestly: another tool, or another agent?
en.where: On paper
en.do: State the second agent's job in one sentence. If it needs two sentences, you are splitting in the wrong place.
en.see: One clean sentence, with an owner who is not you.
en.note: A different job with a different owner is an agent. The same job with an extra data source is a tool. Getting this backwards is how organisations end up with forty agents and no owners.

zh.act: 老实判断：再加个工具，还是拆个 agent？
zh.where: 写在纸上
zh.do: 用一句话写出第二个 agent 的职责。要两句才说得清，就是拆错地方了。
zh.see: 一句干净的话，背后站着一个不是你的负责人。
zh.note: 不同的活、不同的主人，那是 agent；同一件活多一个数据源，那是工具。这两个搞反了，公司最后会有四十个 agent 而没有一个主人。

en.act: Connect the second agent
en.where: Build → Connected agents → Add multi agent
en.do: Publish the second agent first, then connect it and describe the route by when to hand over — not by what the other agent is.
en.type: Hand over to this agent when the question is about leave, payroll or benefits. Do not hand over expense questions, even when they mention a salary figure.
en.see: Only published agents can be selected. Drafts are listed but greyed out, with a line telling you to publish them first.
en.note: That publish requirement catches every room. Build the second agent, publish it, and only then come back here — otherwise you will spend ten minutes wondering why the list is dead.

zh.act: 把第二个 agent 接上
zh.where: Build → Connected agents → Add multi agent
zh.do: 先把第二个 agent 发布，再回来接；路由描述写「什么时候该转过去」，不要写「那个 agent 是什么」。
zh.type: Hand over to this agent when the question is about leave, payroll or benefits. Do not hand over expense questions, even when they mention a salary figure.
zh.see: 只有已发布的 agent 能选。草稿会列出来但是灰的，旁边一行字告诉你先去发布。
zh.note: 这个「必须先发布」每一场都会卡人。先建、先发布，再回这里——否则你会对着一个点不动的列表发十分钟呆。

en.act: Ask the clear case, then the one that spans both
en.where: Preview tab
en.do: Ask the question that plainly belongs to the second agent. Then ask one that genuinely needs both.
en.see: The first hands over cleanly. The second either splits the work sensibly or picks a side and hides the fact.
en.note: The spanning question is the real test. Handing over cleanly is easy; knowing that half a question was dropped is not.

zh.act: 先问界限分明的，再问跨两边的
zh.where: Preview 页签
zh.do: 先问一个明显属于第二个 agent 的，再问一个真的两边都需要的。
zh.see: 第一个干干净净地转了；第二个要么把活拆得很合理，要么选了一边并且不告诉你。
zh.note: 跨两边那个才是真正的考题。转得干净不难，难的是知道有一半问题被丢了。

en.act: Check what actually crossed the boundary
en.where: Preview tab → the reasoning trace on the handover
en.do: Read every field of context that went across, and ask whether the receiving team is allowed to hold it.
en.see: Usually more than you expected — conversation history travels with the request unless you decided otherwise.
en.note: This is the question security asks first, and the one nobody prepares for. Answer it here, not in a review meeting.

zh.act: 看清楚到底有什么越过了边界
zh.where: Preview 页签 → 交接那一步的推理轨迹
zh.do: 把传过去的上下文逐个字段读一遍，问一句：接收那边有没有资格拿着它。
zh.see: 通常比你以为的多——你不特意处理的话，对话历史是跟着请求一起走的。
zh.note: 这是安全会先问的那一句，也是没人提前准备的那一句。在这里把它答了，别等到评审会上。

en.act: Confirm an auditor could follow it without you
en.where: The trace, and the Monitor tab afterwards
en.do: Find the handover again from the record alone, as somebody who was not in the conversation.
en.see: Which agent was called, with what, and what came back.
en.note: Two agents is where responsibility starts getting passed around. If the trail breaks at the handover, so does the accountability.

zh.act: 确认审计的人不靠你也追得下去
zh.where: 推理轨迹，以及事后的 Monitor 页签
zh.do: 把自己当成一个当时不在场的人，只靠记录把那次交接重新找出来。
zh.see: 调了哪个 agent、传了什么、回来了什么。
zh.note: 一到两个 agent，责任就开始互相推了。轨迹在交接处断了，责任也就断在那里。

en.name: Show it, then hand it over
en.teaches: Presenting a build as a business case rather than a feature tour, and closing out what an owner needs in order to keep it alive.
en.build: Five minutes a sponsor can act on, and a named owner for whatever happens next.
en.objective: Present what you built so a sponsor can decide, and hand it to someone who can keep it running.

materials: Your before-baseline, your test results, and the name of the person who will own this afterwards

steps: Structure it in three: how the work is done today, what changes, and the evidence.
Demonstrate live, and include one failure or refusal — a run where nothing goes wrong proves nothing.
Show the pass rate and the baseline together, and say aloud what those numbers do not cover.
Take one challenge from the room on where this would break in production, and answer it without defending.
Close the handover: who owns it, what they may change alone, and what happens the day it starts answering badly.
Write the shortest honest verdict — pilot, rebuild, or stop — and put a name against it.
en.summary: Somebody with authority can now make a decision about this, and somebody with a name is responsible for it afterwards.

zh.name: 演示出来，然后交出去
zh.teaches: 把一次建设讲成一件业务上成立的事，而不是功能巡演；以及收尾时接手的人到底需要什么才能把它养下去。
zh.build: 五分钟，讲完出资方能拍板；以及一个写了名字的负责人。
zh.objective: 能把成果讲到出资方可以做决定，并把它交到一个能把它养下去的人手里。

materials: 改之前的基线、测试结果、以及之后由谁负责的那个人名

steps: 按三段搭：这活现在怎么干、之后变成什么样、证据是什么。
现场演示，并且必须演一次失败或拒绝——全程顺利的演示什么也证明不了。
把通过率和基线放在一起给，并当场说清这些数字盖不住哪些情况。
接住现场一个「这东西上生产会在哪垮」的质疑，正面回答，不要辩护。
把交接收掉：谁负责、他可以自己改哪些、以及它开始乱答的那天该怎么办。
写下最短的那句实话——试点、重做、还是停——并在后面签上名字。
zh.summary: 有决定权的人现在能对它做决定了，而且之后有一个具体的人对它负责。

en.act: Structure it in three, and time it
en.where: Before the room fills up
en.do: How the work is done today, what changes, and the evidence. Rehearse once against a clock.
en.see: Five minutes is shorter than everyone assumes — usually about nine sentences.
en.note: No architecture slide. Nobody in the room is deciding whether your topology is elegant; they are deciding whether to fund the next step.

zh.act: 按三段搭，并且计个时
zh.where: 人还没到齐之前
zh.do: 这活现在怎么干、之后变成什么样、证据是什么。对着表过一遍。
zh.see: 五分钟比所有人以为的短——大概就九句话。
zh.note: 不要放架构图。在场没有人在判断你的拓扑漂不漂亮，他们在判断要不要给下一步掉钱。

en.act: Demonstrate live, including one failure
en.where: The published agent, in the channel real users use
en.do: Run the normal case, then deliberately run one it refuses or cannot do.
en.see: The room relaxes at exactly the moment you show the failure. That is not a coincidence.
en.note: A demo where nothing goes wrong proves nothing and everyone knows it. Showing the boundary is what makes the rest believable.

zh.act: 现场演，并且必须演一次失败
zh.where: 已发布的 agent，在真用户用的那个渠道里
zh.do: 先跑正常情况，再故意跑一个它会拒绝或办不到的。
zh.see: 你演到失败那一刻，屋子里的人反而松了口气。这不是巧合。
zh.note: 全程顺利的演示什么也证明不了，而且大家心里都清楚。把边界演出来，剩下的才有人信。

en.act: Show the pass rate and the baseline together
en.where: One slide, or one sentence
en.do: Give the test pass rate, the before-number, and say aloud what the numbers do not cover.
en.see: Two figures that mean different things: fit to ship, and worth shipping.
en.note: Quoting one without the other is the standard mistake. A 95% pass rate on a process nobody wanted improved is still a no.

zh.act: 通过率和基线一起给
zh.where: 一页，或一句话
zh.do: 给出测试通过率、改之前的数，并当场说清这些数盖不住什么。
zh.see: 两个数回答两件事：能不能上，以及值不值得上。
zh.note: 只给其中一个是典型错误。一个没人在乎的流程，通过率 95% 也依然是不。

en.act: Take one challenge without defending
en.where: In the room
en.do: Ask where this would break in production, and write the answer down instead of arguing with it.
en.see: Usually a failure mode you knew about and hoped nobody would raise.
en.note: Whoever raises it has just done your risk assessment for free. Argue and they will stop — and you will find out about it in production instead.

zh.act: 接住一个质疑，不要辩护
zh.where: 就在会场上
zh.do: 主动问「这东西上生产会在哪垂」，把回答记下来，而不是反驳它。
zh.see: 通常是一个你自己也知道、只是希望没人提的坑。
zh.note: 提出来的那个人刚白帮你做了一次风险评估。你一辩，他就不说了——然后你会在生产环境里知道。

en.act: Close the handover out loud
en.where: The last minute of the session
en.do: Say who owns it, what they may change alone, and what happens the day it starts answering badly.
en.see: Sometimes an owner. Sometimes a silence that tells you this was never going to production.
en.note: An agent with no named owner is already decommissioned; it just has not noticed yet. Say the name in the room.

zh.act: 当众把交接收掉
zh.where: 这一节的最后一分钟
zh.do: 说清楚：谁负责、他可以自己改哪些、以及它开始乱答那天该怎么办。
zh.see: 有时候会出现一个负责人。有时候是一阵沉默——那就告诉你它本来就上不了生产。
zh.note: 没有名字负责的 agent 已经死了，只是它自己还不知道。把那个名字当众说出来。

en.act: Write the shortest honest verdict
en.where: The acceptance sheet
en.do: Pilot, rebuild, or stop. One of the three, with a name against it.
en.see: A line somebody is prepared to sign.
en.note: 'Stop' is a successful outcome for this programme. Learning in six weeks that a scenario does not work is the whole point of running a pilot.

zh.act: 写下最短的那句实话
zh.where: 验收表上
zh.do: 试点、重做、还是停。三选一，后面签名。
zh.see: 一行有人愿意签字的字。
zh.note: 「停」也是这个计划的成功结果。花六周弄清楚一个场景不成立，本来就是试点存在的意义。
